notes:
**Signing in destroyed the rules of anyone who had not yet placed a trade.** The "two accounts found" question only checked whether you had paper TRADES on the phone. If you had spent two evenings building strategies and a watchlist but had not traded yet, the check saw an empty device, never asked, and overwrote your strategies, watchlists, alerts, drawings and coach setup from an old cloud copy. No banner, no message. It asks about everything now.

**And the button that would have saved them did nothing.** "Use my saved account" re-raised the same banner forever - your cloud copy was never restored, and the only button that worked was the one that destroyed it.

**Replay printed a gross number and called it "Net".** No brokerage, no STT, no exchange fee, no stamp, no GST - on the screen where you learn what a scalp is worth. A two-point NIFTY scalp read "Net Rs 150" and is actually a loss. It pays real charges now and shows what was paid beside what was kept.

**The journal's profit factor was printing rupees.** One winning trade of 86 paise showed "Profit factor 0.86" in red on an account that had never lost anything.

**Exported spreadsheets were stamped in UTC on Upstox accounts** - every trade written five and a half hours early, outside market hours, in the file you send to somebody else, while the coverage line on the same sheet had the right dates.

**Six more places read the clock off a candle** - the SIP simulator picked the wrong month, CPR read the wrong previous session, the replay picker showed one day as two half-days, and an expired contract could settle against the wrong session's close.
